title: UNVEILING THE COGNITIVE COMPASS: THEORY-OF-MIND–GUIDED MULTIMODAL EMOTION REASONING
reasoning: The paper focuses on emotional intelligence, Theory of Mind, and multimodal emotion reasoning. It introduces the HitEmotion benchmark and the TMPO method to evaluate and enhance MLLMs in tasks like sarcasm detection, intent analysis, and humor understanding. It does not include a specific evaluation of religious beliefs, faith, or moral/ethical systems beyond a standard ethics statement.
